title: WWE Takes Over Fan Expo Dallas!
htmlContent:
Several WWE Superstars such as the legendary Ric Flair, Undertaker, Sheamus, and Seth Rollins appeared at Fan Expo Dallas over the weekend to sign autographs and take pictures with hundreds of fans. Pictured above is current WWE RAW Superstar Seth Rollins enjoying time meeting with a fan from the WWE Universe.

However, Fan Expo is a lot more than just meeting your favorite wrestlers, comic creators or movie stars. This convention also allows fans to come dressed up as their favorite character whether that be from a movie, tv show, anime or even professional wrestling. Below is a photo of a wrestling fan dressed up as the late Big Bossman.

If you don't know who the Nature Boy Ric Flair is, then you've been living under a rock for the last 30 plus years. Ric famous for being a 16 time World Champion along with his famous catchphrases "Wooo" and "To Be The Man, You've Got To Beat The Man". Flair is 73 years young but still as entertaining as ever whenever he has a microphone in hand. After starting his early career in Dallas at the old Sportatorium, he returned to the city to greet fans at the Expo.
